# @fluent/syntax 0.19.0 (vendored)

ESM build of [`@fluent/syntax`](https://github.com/projectfluent/fluent.js),
copied verbatim from the npm tarball's `esm/` directory (`.js` files only; the
`.d.ts` files were dropped).

This is the JavaScript counterpart of the Python `fluent.syntax` package that
`browser/extensions/newtab/mach_commands.py` uses, so the Fluent files here are
parsed by the same grammar the in-tree tooling uses.
